dg-fmr-hermit-crab-diet.title: FMR Hermit Crab Diet
dg-fmr-hermit-crab-diet.summary: A dry staple food for land hermit crabs, made with food oils to help crabs molt successfully. Feed it alongside a variety of unsalted fresh foods.
rows: Corn meal, soybean meal, alfalfa meal, animal and plant protein products, soybean and coconut oil
Calcium carbonate plus added vitamins and minerals
notes: Give hermit crabs a varied diet: fresh fruit, vegetables, meat, fish, nuts and seeds, all unsalted, along with this food.
warn: Never feed salted foods. The added iodine in table salt is harmful to hermit crabs.
